decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting has long certification cycles and niche demand, so the firm keeps the option open while uncertainty remains and maintenance costs are relatively low.
General interior lighting is a competitive market, but the firm keeps the product while its value is still uncertain and dropping it would release resources only if results clearly deteriorate.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics is actively promoted as a recent and intriguing release, indicating the firm sees strong option value and will continue investing.
Marine searchlights are a specialized niche and the firm has already dropped a similar HMI variant, so it retains this option while demand remains uncertain and costs are manageable.
